source_name: Association LinkedIn company pages (Czech Fintech Association, ČKMA, AmCham CZ)
why_relevant: Association pages surface event speakers, new-member announcements and staff, and the 'people' tab exposes who lists the association among their roles — a live people-graph layered on top of the static member directory.

Union social channels often carry faster, blunter statements about a specific bank's redundancy round than the website, plus recruitment drives at newly-unionising employers. Useful for real-time signal, weak for archival reliability.

source_name: Finmag.cz — obchodní rejstřík (Partners media register mirror)
why_relevant: Financial-media-hosted register mirror; relevant because it sits inside a finance publication, so register records and editorial coverage of the same bank/fintech are cross-linked — a cheap bridge from a filing to press narrative for the same entity.

source_name: Apify — Obchodni Rejstrik Downloader (third-party scraper actor)
why_relevant: Off-the-shelf scraper actor for the CZ commercial register. Relevant mainly as evidence of how others solve the extraction problem and as a fallback if the official open data proves too coarse — but scraping or.justice.cz is inferior and riskier than using dataor.justice.cz/ARES API, so treat as low priority.

source_name: Banking Innovation Forum & Expo (Cubex Centrum Praha listing)
why_relevant: A long-running (17th+ edition) banking-innovation forum held in Prague. The venue's event listing is a reliable pointer to the edition, dates and organiser even when the organiser's own site is short-lived; venue pages also enumerate other finance events at the same site.

Cashless-payments conference site surfaced in cs search; its programme/contacts sections name organisers and speakers on the cashless/acceptance side. Latest confirmed edition observed is 2022, so it may be dormant — value is mainly as an archived roster for back-dating roles, and it must be re-checked before being treated as live.

Third-party front ends over ISIR offering easier name-based lookup and monitoring than the official form. Useful only as a convenience/alerting layer; all findings must be confirmed in isir.justice.cz.
Smaller CZ board with clean sector+city URL structure; useful as a third independent count to sanity-check Jobs.cz/Indeed regional hiring trends.

source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – List of supervised entities + fit-and-proper explainer (cs available)
why_relevant: CZ is not in the euro area / SSM, so ECB does not approve CZ bank boards — but ECB material sets the fit-and-proper vocabulary ČNB mirrors, and the periodic list-of-supervised-entities PDFs matter for CZ subsidiaries of SSM parent groups, where group-level leadership decisions drive local changes.

11th edition (Hotel Jalta, Praha), run by consumer-finance server Měšec.cz with moderator Dalibor Z. Chvátal. Speaker line-ups skew to product and digital-channel leads at banks, insurers and fintechs; multiple independent media recaps (Měšec, Euro.cz, Ekonomický magazín) name the speakers, giving redundant capture when the event page itself is thin.
Aggregates regional press coverage and local job ads (incl. náborový příspěvek offers) for Královéhradecký kraj — a pointer into smaller outlets in a region otherwise invisible.
Small free regional paper/portal; carries employer profiles and hiring features that never reach national media.
Independent CZ HR magazine with a dedicated 'trh práce' section; smaller than HR News but carries recruiter commentary and labour-market pieces, useful as a redundancy pointer.
Portal-attached board reaching a different, more local candidate pool; back-office and administrative bank roles in Brno often appear here.

source_name: Printec Group — solutions & customer stories (ATM ecosystem)
why_relevant: Printec-type multivendor integrator publishing its NCR Atleos partnership, managed-service scope and bank customer stories. Establishes the competitive supplier set for CZ self-service and cash-handling managed services; new CZ customer stories or a CZ delivery-unit announcement would signal demand shift.

source_name: Reddit r/czech and r/CzechRepublic (employee/job discussion threads)
why_relevant: Where younger CZ white-collar staff discuss employers, pay and reorganisations candidly, often mixing cs and en; complements Atmoskop for firms with few reviews. Lowest signal-to-noise in the cell but occasionally the earliest mention.
Brno/Jihomoravský kraj news, company catalogue and vacancy listings; a secondary sweep layer for local employer hiring outside the big job boards.
Regional news + company directory + job listings aggregator for Ostrava/MS kraj; low editorial value but useful as a cheap sweep of local hiring notices.

SEE/CEE business wire with a banking vertical; picks up Czech-linked corporate and subsidiary news. Caveat: its core geography is Southeast Europe, so CZ coverage is incidental rather than systematic.

source_name: SpeedCard s.r.o. — authorised Entrust Datacard distributor for CZ (card personalisation lines)
why_relevant: Distributor of card printers, embossers and personalisation lines in CZ since 2007. Equipment distributors are an early-warning layer: personalisation-line sales precede issuer capacity changes at banks. Also useful for mapping the smaller CZ card-production actors (BlackCard, Card Centrum, M CARD) that serve bank-adjacent issuing.

source_name: SPIR — Sdružení pro internetový rozvoj: předsednictvo a členové
why_relevant: SPIR publishes its executive board with named people and employers (reported: Michal Hanák/MAFRA re-elected chair from 16 June 2026; vice-chairs Michal Feix/Seznam.cz and Martin Picek/WPP Media). Relevant to A5 mainly as a digital-economy adjacency and as a template for board-diff monitoring; membership includes the tech/media firms banks buy from.

source_name: Svaz personalistů ČR — Novinky ze světa HR
why_relevant: Second CZ HR-professional body aggregating HR news; low volume but occasionally carries recruiter/sector items not picked up by HR News.
